parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the WAF ruleset.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description:
The WAF rule execution phase. Valid values:

- http\_whitelist

- http\_custom

- http\_managed

- http\_anti\_scan

- http\_ratelimit

- ip\_access\_rule

- http\_bot

- http\_security\_level\_rule

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. To get this ID, call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The site configuration version. This parameter applies only if versioning is enabled for the site. The default is 0.
